test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Five boys Aman, Baman, Chaman, Daman and Farhan have different ages. Farhan is elder than only Aman and Baman. Daman is younger than only Chaman. Aman is not the youngest. How many boys are elder than Aman?
solution:
Given: Five boys Aman, Baman, Chaman, Daman and Farhan have different ages.

1) Daman is younger than only Chaman.

Chaman > Daman > __ > __ > __

2) Farhan is elder than only Aman and Baman.

3) Aman is not the youngest.

Chaman > Daman > Farhan > Aman > Baman

So, total '**3**' boys are elder than Aman.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
